prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original game UI sprite, a glorious winged aviation victory badge on transparent background, landscape composition. Detailed 1990s Amiga painted pixel art matching the rich warm brown/cream/red game artwork in the reference. A central broad dark navy enamel plaque with an EMPTY unobstructed horizontal centre for game-rendered text, around 45% of total width, surrounded by sweeping layered silver feathers with warm brass edging and a small red/gold biplane roundel above. Wings spread symmetrically sideways, elegant aerodynamic stepped feathers, carved metallic highlights, tiny rivets, a small laurel flourish below. Exuberant heroic flight-adventure mood. Keep realistic sprite texture and beautiful hand-shaded raster detail. Absolutely NO words, letters, numbers or logos, no WINGS logo, no copies of another game's emblem. Blank readable centre. Full badge fits comfortably within image with generous transparent margin. No scenery or shadow plane. One badge only, preferably 1536x1024 with the wide badge occupying the middle third vertically.

Use case: identity-preserve. ONE transparent raster sprite sheet for the existing cream-and-red player biplane in the TOP LEFT of the input atlas. Preserve that exact airplane identity, cream upper wing, red cowling/body panels, tricolour tail, blue-white-red roundels, wooden struts and exposed rigging. Four rear-view flight poses in an exact 2x2 grid on a 1536x1024 transparent PNG. Each equal 768x512 cell has the whole airplane clearly isolated inside generous transparent gutters, same physical scale and centre. Top-left: rear three-quarter view banking gently left, seen from behind flying AWAY from viewer. Top-right: straight rear view with broad two-level wings, tail and distant cockpit visible. Bottom-left: rear banking gently right. Bottom-right: rear level with a slight upward climb. Plane is always flying away, never facing the viewer. Detailed shaded Amiga-era painted pixel-art sprites, rich cloth/wood/metal texture and readable outlines exactly like reference art, no simplified vector/LEGO geometry, no block placeholders, no scenery, no labels or text, no motion streaks, no sky. Airframe dimensions consistent across poses. No other vehicles.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original cockpit UI sprite ATLAS, 1536x1024 transparent PNG, richly detailed Amiga-era painted pixel art for a cheerful 1920s biplane adventure. Exact layout: TOP HALF y0..512 is one rectangular dashboard background spanning full width, beautifully textured honey-brown woodgrain with dark brown leather padding along the top, stitched seams, brass corner screws and restrained worn metal trims. Keep the wood surface mostly plain and unobstructed so live game HUD can overlay text and a map. NO circular instruments in this top half, no words or numbers. BOTTOM HALF y512..1024 contains THREE isolated UI sprites in equal 512x512 cells: LEFT: perfectly circular antique brass-rimmed airspeed instrument with a dark charcoal EMPTY face, no needle and no numerals/ticks; MIDDLE: perfectly circular antique brass-rimmed altimeter, similarly EMPTY dark face, no needle/ticks/numerals; RIGHT: a wide small riveted brass nameplate/frame with empty dark interior. All three are isolated on genuine transparent backgrounds, comfortably inset in their cells. Refined natural worn highlights and handpainted raster texture, never simple flat vector shapes. Orthographic front-facing instruments, no perspective tilt. Do not draw any text, labels, logos, hands, cockpit view or scenery. Render exact atlas layout and no overlapping sprites.

Use case: illustration-story. Original 1536x1024 full-frame background illustration for an Amiga-era flight arcade game's pause menu and high-score debrief, matching the reference's warm painted pixel-art palette and detailed raster shading. Cheerful peaceful grass airfield after a flight, late-afternoon golden light, cream-and-red vintage biplane parked on the RIGHT HALF next to a modest canvas hangar. On the right foreground an original brown-leather-helmeted aviator with round goggles, cream scarf, brown flight suit and olive parachute pack sits beside a tool crate drinking from a tin mug, looking relieved and a little tired. Ground crew silhouette and a small windsock in distance. Blue sky, puffed cream clouds, distant teal-green hills, subtle rainbow far away. The LEFT HALF must remain relatively quiet: sky above and grass below with low-contrast scenery, no foreground characters there; game menus and a high-score table will be overlaid on this side. Do not draw any UI, menus, letters, numbers, titles, logos or badges. Not a copy of Wings or any other game scene. Detailed nostalgic handpainted Amiga-style pixel art, visibly crafted pixels/dithering but not crude block art or vectors. Rich pleasant colours compatible with Rainbow Patrol, no death, gore, gritty realism, sepia wash or monochrome. A complete scenic background, not transparent.

parachute.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent raster animation sprite sheet for this exact existing aviator descending under a parachute. Input reference: the original project's detailed pilot/parachute image, specifically the cream parachute and brown aviator in the bottom middle and the burning red parachute at bottom right. Create ONE 1536x1024 transparent PNG, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, equal 384x512 cells. Each cell contains one complete canopy, suspension ropes and hanging pilot with boots, comfortably inside its cell with transparent gutters. Top row: 4 sequential gentle pendulum poses of the ORIGINAL cream parachute: lean left with pilot swinging right, near-level with left knee bent, lean right with pilot swinging left, near-level with right knee bent. Bottom row: the same four poses using the ORIGINAL burning red/orange damaged canopy with small fire varying between frames. Keep the aviator's exact identity, round goggles, leather flying helmet, brown leather flight suit, cream scarf, olive backpack and harness. Legs and scarf move gently across frames, hands remain holding the suspension risers. Canopy tilts only 6 to 10 degrees and ropes follow the hanging weight, never a deformed balloon. Uniform scale, framing, centre and boot-baseline for all cells. Match the reference's richly shaded Amiga-era painted pixel art, textured cloth, clear detailed outlines, warm lighting. Preserve its original appealing quality, do NOT simplify to geometric/vector/stick/block sprites. No AA guns, no extra people, no landscape, no ground, no shadows below the characters, no text or labels, no borders, no watermark. Actual transparent background with clean alpha. This is gentle continuous descending motion, not a new character redesign.
